name: about-sass
title: About SaaS Company
blurb: SaaS product about section with features and integrations showcase.
description: A SaaS-focused about section featuring feature cards with icons (Global Network, Scaling, Security), integrations list, and benefit-driven messaging with scroll animations.
use_when: SaaS product landing pages and about sections showcasing technical features and integrations.
avoid_when: When custom features and integrations are needed; uses hardcoded feature list and copy.
a11y: Feature cards with icons and text; integrations rendered as plain list; motion animations on scroll.
